entries.title: Settlement rounding assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The settlement calculator rounds midpoint values away from zero, while the settlement contract requires rounding to even.

entries.title: Restore cannot find a package version
entries.root_cause: The project references version 7.4.2 of the QuayMath package, which is not available from its configured package source.

entries.title: Ledger export omits the header
entries.root_cause: The CSV exporter no longer writes the required header row when exporting an empty ledger.

entries.title: Settlement rounding assertion fails on newer image
entries.root_cause: The settlement calculator rounds midpoint values away from zero, while the settlement contract requires rounding to even.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses ubuntu-24.04, a different SDK patch, a different checkout and test duration; unrelated tests and source line numbers have changed.
